title: Benin calculator readiness research — Batch 37
scope: Research evidence and 12-department geographic lookup only. No calculator formulas or active country profiles changed.

findings.detail: FAO confirms Benin released ESA 2024 data on 11 June 2026. The survey includes crop areas, production, yields, input use and harvest/post-harvest losses. Detailed tables and datasets still need extraction.

INStaD reports 2,737,481 tonnes aggregate cereal production, versus a five-year average of 2,219,312 tonnes. It says output growth reflected area expansion while cereal yields generally declined. This is aggregate cereals, not commodity-specific yield.

FAO's 10 June 2026 brief estimates 2025 aggregate cereal production at about 2.9 million tonnes, about 20% above the previous five-year average. April 2026 cereal prices were below year-earlier levels, but no absolute farmgate values were added.
IGN-Bénin identifies 12 departments, 77 communes, 546 arrondissements and 5,295 villages/neighbourhoods. The first-level 12 departments are now in the calculator region lookup.

blockers: ESA 2024 detailed tables and metadata not extracted; current evidence confirms scope but not usable crop/department rows.
No absolute dated farmgate price series with grade, unit and market level has been validated.
Input-use coverage is confirmed but farmer purchase prices and full operating cost schedules are missing.
No department-specific enterprise budgets or calculator regression cases.
Current crop statistics use area sown as the yield denominator; preserve this definition and reconcile with harvested area where available.
next_steps: Extract ESA 2024 downloadable datasets and metadata.
Extract crop-specific campaign tables and reconcile area-sown yield definitions.
Obtain dated farmgate prices and farmer input quotations.
Build department-level enterprise budgets and calculator test cases before activation.
